items.label: la piqûre
items.scene: A curious bee, a little PEEKER ("pee-KEWR"), peeks at the tiny red dot of a STING on a boy's arm while the nurse holds an ice cube.

items.label: la chirurgie
items.scene: SHE ("shee-rewr-ZHEE"), a girl in a paper cap, does SURGERY on her teddy's ear with a toy kit, steady as a pro.

items.label: l'exploitation
items.scene: A hen manager runs the hospital laundry OPERATION ("ehk-splwah-tah-SYOHN") with a clipboard, sheets flapping.

items.label: l'injection
items.scene: A brave puppy gets his INJECTION ("an-zhehk-SYOHN"), the nurse holding a capped syringe prop, and wins a squeaky bone.

items.label: le chirurgien
items.scene: The SURGEON ("shee-rewr-ZHYAN") in a green cap scrubs her hands at the sink, humming two whole songs.

items.label: le dégât
items.scene: DAMAGE! one DAY ("day") a GOAT ("GAH") wandered in and chewed the mop, leaving a puddle and torn paper towels.

items.label: le détachement
items.scene: A calm cat with a white MOUSTACHE ("day-tah-shuh-MAHN") watches the goat chaos with DETACHMENT, washing a paw.

items.label: l'opérateur
items.scene: The OPERATOR ("oh-pay-rah-TUHR"), a technician in a TOUR guide's cap, swings the big round theatre lamp into place.
